runs.text: In Unicode, some accented letters can be written in two ways: as a single character or as a letter followed by an accent. To compare names, the engine first converts them to the same form, called
is always the same name, however you type it. Quoted texts are not touched.
A position counts lines and columns from 1 and characters from 0. A span includes its start and excludes its end. A text that is not valid UTF-8 is not analysed: it is reported as an input failure.

points.text: Every character has a line and a column from 1.
Names are compared after normalising to NFC; texts are not modified.
